snippet.title: Grip 2: Combat Racing Evolved - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Check out gameplay and features, like the level editor, in this latest Grip 2: Combat Racing Evolved trailer for this upcoming fast and futuristic combat racing game sequel with rocket-powered, flippable vehicles. Race with unique movement tech and use powerful weapons and abilities to beat your opponents to the finish line. Grip 2 will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
